1-15231-2-1.subevent: At least four civilians were killed and 10 others were wounded in a mortar attack in northern Faryab province on Thursday morning.
The incident happened around 11:00am local time after a mortar round landed in a market in Shareen Tagab district of the province.
Abdul Karim Yourish, a spokesman for the provincial police chief, said the mortar was fired by the Taliban to target the security forces, but all the victims were civilians at the market to shop.
The Taliban has not commented on the attack.

0-4495-1-1.subevent: Tunisia Youth Impact is using cooking contests to encourage young Tunisian women in rural villages to vote in the presidential election.
On October 12, in Echamine, the day before the presidential runoff, the first round's turnout was just 48.98%.
Wafa Tarhouni says the contest is a 'practice vote' where women compete through dishes to be elected by diners.
Volunteers replicate real voting conditions, with the ink replaced by water and shampoo.
Hinda Jlass, hosting the contest in her half-built home, prepares couscous, says participation is essential, and plans to vote on Sunday for only the second time.
At noon, seven competitors present their dishes to about fifty electors, who taste and vote using the same procedure as the presidential ballot, with volunteers guiding them.
Members of the ISIE and EU observer Stefan Ziegler attend; Ziegler says it can only be good for Tunisian democracy.
After the vote, ballots are counted and volunteers point out mistakes that might invalidate a vote.
Najwa Jlass wins and says she will vote 'for real' the next day.
